36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
196521: Shin is a ex-hitman turned employee who works for Sakamoto. He has the ability to hear the thoughts of those around him.
196522: Tarou Sakamoto is a retired hitman. He was the greatest hitman, feared and revered by bad guys and hitmen everywhere. However, he left the hitman world in order to be with his wife. He currently owns a store, and has one child.
207272: Lu Shaotang is the daughter of a Triad Family, which is always being hunted down for their wealth and to get revenge for the past actions of the family. She meets Sakamoto when he saves her from assassins sent to steal a key to her family's safe.
212302: Aoi is the wife of Tarou Sakamoto and mother of Hana Sakamoto. She met Tarou at a convenience store where he fell in love with Aoi. Soon after the two married and had a daughter.
252687: Heisuke Mashimo is a low-ranking assassin whose main skill is sharpshooting. Heisuke ended up losing his job, causing him to seek out Tarou Sakamoto's bounty in order to turn his luck around.
264336: Nagumo is an old friend of Sakamoto. He is a member of "The Order", a group of assassins who are the highest ranked in the JAA. He's first seen paying a visit to Sakamoto to inform him of his bounty.
266969: Osaragi is an assassin and a new member of the Order, a group of powerful assassins that work under the JAA.
272873: Boiled is an assassin obsessed with being "hard boiled" and works for the assassin agency Dodenkai with Obiguro. He knew Sakamoto at the JCC and uses ball bombs to fight.
272875: An old man carrying a katana. He is an assassin from The Order, a group consisting of the strongest members within the JAA.
272877: Hana Sakamoto is daughter of Tarou Sakamoto and Aoi Sakamoto.
272878: Uzuki, also known as Slur, is a killer seeking to overthrow the JAA. Roughly around the same time Tarou Sakamoto's bounty was put up, Uzuki murdered a quarter of the assassin industry. The Order deemed him "X" as he leaves a large red 'X' at the scene of his crimes.
272879: Shishiba is an assassin and member of The Order, a group of powerful assassins tasked with keeping the order within the Japanese Assassin Association (JAA). His weapon of choice is a claw hammer.
